scenarios.name: German generic questions preserve literal search without invented topics
scenarios.given: German lexical and Apple embedding assets plus the unchanged saved topical corpus
scenarios.when: History searches generic meeting or temporal variations and asks about generic plans
scenarios.then: no semantic Related topics or plan-based Ask excerpts appear; an exact literal conversation remains searchable

scenarios.name: Spanish generic questions preserve literal search without invented topics
scenarios.given: Spanish lexical and Apple embedding assets plus the unchanged saved topical corpus
scenarios.when: History searches generic meeting or temporal variations and asks about generic plans
scenarios.then: no semantic Related topics or plan-based Ask excerpts appear; an exact literal conversation remains searchable

scenarios.name: A genuine topic inside generic wording remains retrievable
scenarios.given: the same German and Spanish generic scaffolding with a saved travel topic added
scenarios.when: History searches and retrieves excerpts through actual Apple models
scenarios.then: the travel conversation remains Related and eligible for an Ask request; word and sentence queries survive and persisted vectors are unchanged

scenarios.name: Stored sentence models enforce known generic-query refusal
scenarios.given: actual German and Spanish sentence model tags with installed lexical evidence
scenarios.when: History generates queries for generic meeting and temporal wording
scenarios.then: no sentence query bypasses known insufficient topic content

scenarios.name: Optional runtime respects generic refusal while preserving topic queries
scenarios.given: installed actual optional model assets and supported German and Spanish lexical tagging
scenarios.when: the optional adapter receives generic queries and the same wording plus real travel content
scenarios.then: generic queries produce no vectors while genuine topic queries retain actual finite optional-model vectors

scenarios.name: Query filtering preserves compounds and uncertain capability
scenarios.given: German compounds, ambiguous unhinted single words and an actually unavailable lexical language
scenarios.when: History evaluates topic eligibility and literal terms
scenarios.then: whole compounds survive; unhinted one-word queries retain actual Apple compatibility; ambiguity and unavailable classification stay unknown without downloads

scenarios.name: Ask excludes translated generic scaffolding but keeps concrete terms
scenarios.given: German and Spanish equivalents of existing English Ask stopword concepts
scenarios.then: generic plan and week framing is removed while passport, compound, named topic and short Chinese terms remain

scenarios.name: Single unhinted Ask terms retain prior lexical meaning
scenarios.given: one unhinted word that a language guess could classify as German or Spanish generic framing
scenarios.then: the new localized exclusions do not erase that ambiguous word; existing English exclusions remain unchanged
